B
+72.0 cm
C
+25.0 cm

+50.0 cm

Domain: Engineering · Unit: Second Law of Thermodynamics & Carnot Cycle · Topic: Reversible Carnot Heat Engine T-S Diagram

A reversible heat engine operates on the Carnot cycle shown on the temperature-entropy (T-S) diagram between TH=1200 K and TL=360 K. If heat absorbed during isothermal expansion 2–3 is Qin=240 kJ, find the net work output enclosed by the cycle.

A
72.0 kJ
B
214.0 kJ
C
168.0 kJ
✓ Correct
D
55.38 kJ
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option C)

Thermal efficiency from the T-S rectangle is η=1-3601200=0.7. Net work output equals the rectangular enclosed cycle area Wnet=η·Qin=168.0 kJ (whereas Option A represents heat rejected Q_out to the low-temperature sink).
